title: vramfit contributed measurement
description: One measurement, from one machine, with enough provenance to be worth keeping. Every required field is required because a report without it has already turned out to be unreproducible.

model.description: The model as published, not a nickname. 'Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct', not '8b'.

bits_per_weight.description: From `vramfit shape`, if a GGUF was used.

backend_version.description: A build commit or a release version. 'latest' is not a version and will be rejected.

nvidia_smi.description: Verbatim output of `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,memory.total,driver_version --format=csv`. This is the field that settles arguments about which card a number came from.

reported_by.description: Optional. A GitHub handle, if you want the row attributed.
